```{python}

import requests
import pandas as pd
import os

OUT = "data"
os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)

# ── 1. Census SAIPE poverty by state (API, no key needed) ─────────────────
url = (
    "https://api.census.gov/data/2022/acs/acs1"
    "?get=NAME,B17001_001E,B17001_002E&for=state:*"
)

r = requests.get(url, timeout=15)
data = r.json()
df_poverty = pd.DataFrame(data[1:], columns=data[0])
df_poverty.columns = ["state", "total_pop", "below_poverty", "state_fips"]
df_poverty["poverty_rate"] = (
    df_poverty["below_poverty"].astype(float)
    / df_poverty["total_pop"].astype(float) * 100
).round(2)
df_poverty.to_csv(f"{OUT}/poverty_by_state.csv", index=False)
print(f"Poverty: {df_poverty.shape[0]} states saved")

# ── 2. CDC BRFSS food hardship (Socrata API, no key needed) ───────────────
url2 = "https://chronicdata.cdc.gov/resource/dttw-5yxu.json?$limit=5000"
r2 = requests.get(url2, timeout=15)
df_cdc = pd.DataFrame(r2.json())
df_cdc.to_csv(f"{OUT}/cdc_brfss_food.csv", index=False)
print(f"CDC BRFSS: {df_cdc.shape[0]} rows, columns: {list(df_cdc.columns)[:6]}")

```

#### Poverty Dataset
```{python}
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel(
    "data/Poverty2023.xlsx",
    sheet_name="Poverty Data 2023",
    skiprows=4
)

# ── Keep state-level rows only (FIPS ends in 000, exclude US total 00000) ──
df["FIPS_Code"] = df["FIPS_Code"].astype(str).str.zfill(5)
states = df[
    df["FIPS_Code"].str.endswith("000") &
    (df["FIPS_Code"] != "00000")
].copy()

# ── Keep only the columns we need ─────────────────────────────────────────
cols = {
    "Stabr": "state_abbr",
    "Area_Name": "state",
    "PCTPOVALL_2023": "poverty_all",
    "PCTPOV017_2023": "poverty_children_u17",
    "PCTPOV517_2023": "poverty_children_5to17",
    "PCTPOV04_2023":  "poverty_children_u4",
    "MEDHHINC_2023":  "median_income",
    "POVALL_2023":    "pop_in_poverty",
    "POV017_2023":    "children_in_poverty"
}
states = states[list(cols.keys())].rename(columns=cols)
states = states.reset_index(drop=True)

# ── Save ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
states.to_csv("data/states_poverty_clean.csv", index=False)

print("Rows:", len(states))
print("\nMissing values:\n", states.isnull().sum())
print("\nTop 10 by child poverty rate:")
print(states.nlargest(10, "poverty_children_u17")[
    ["state","poverty_all","poverty_children_u17","median_income"]
])
```

#### Unemployment Dataset
```{python}
# ── 1. Load unemployment, state rows only ─────────────────────────────────
unemp = pd.read_excel("data/Unemployment2023.xlsx", sheet_name=0, 
                       skiprows=4, engine="openpyxl")

unemp["FIPS_Code"] = unemp["FIPS_Code"].astype(str).str.zfill(5)
states_unemp = unemp[
    unemp["FIPS_Code"].str.endswith("000") &
    (unemp["FIPS_Code"] != "00000")
][["State", "Unemployment_rate_2023"]].copy()
states_unemp.columns = ["state_abbr", "unemployment_rate"]
states_unemp = states_unemp.reset_index(drop=True)
print("Unemployment rows:", len(states_unemp))
print(states_unemp.head())

# ── 2. Load poverty clean ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
poverty = pd.read_csv("data/states_poverty_clean.csv")

# ── 3. Merge ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
merged = poverty.merge(states_unemp, on="state_abbr", how="left")
print("\nMerged shape:", merged.shape)
print("Missing unemployment:", merged["unemployment_rate"].isnull().sum())

# ── 4. Quick correlation check ────────────────────────────────────────────
from scipy import stats
for col in ["poverty_all", "poverty_children_u17", "median_income"]:
    r, p = stats.pearsonr(merged[col], merged["unemployment_rate"])
    print(f"unemployment vs {col}: r={r:.3f}, p={p:.3f}")

merged.to_csv("data/master_dataset.csv", index=False)
print("\nSaved master_dataset.csv")
print(merged[["state","poverty_all","poverty_children_u17",
              "median_income","unemployment_rate"]].head(10))
```

#### Population Estimates Dataset

```{python}
import pandas as pd
from scipy import stats

# ── 1. Load population, state rows only ───────────────────────────────────
pop = pd.read_excel("data/PopulationEstimates.xlsx", sheet_name=0,
                    skiprows=4, engine="openpyxl")
pop["FIPStxt"] = pop["FIPStxt"].astype(str).str.zfill(5)
states_pop = pop[
    pop["FIPStxt"].str.endswith("000") &
    (pop["FIPStxt"] != "00000")
][["State", "Area_Name", "POP_ESTIMATE_2023"]].copy()
states_pop.columns = ["state_abbr", "state_name", "population_2023"]
states_pop = states_pop.reset_index(drop=True)
print("Population rows:", len(states_pop))

# ── 2. Load poverty + merge population ────────────────────────────────────
master = pd.read_csv("data/states_poverty_clean.csv")
master = master.merge(states_pop[["state_abbr", "population_2023"]],
                      on="state_abbr", how="left")

# ── 3. Load unemployment + merge ──────────────────────────────────────────
unemp = pd.read_excel("data/Unemployment2023.xlsx", sheet_name=0,
                      skiprows=4, engine="openpyxl")
unemp["FIPS_Code"] = unemp["FIPS_Code"].astype(str).str.zfill(5)
states_unemp = unemp[
    unemp["FIPS_Code"].str.endswith("000") &
    (unemp["FIPS_Code"] != "00000")
][["State", "Unemployment_rate_2023"]].copy()
states_unemp.columns = ["state_abbr", "unemployment_rate"]
master = master.merge(states_unemp, on="state_abbr", how="left")

# ── 4. Derived columns ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
master["people_in_poverty"] = (
    master["population_2023"] * master["poverty_all"] / 100
).round(0).astype(int)

master["children_food_insecure_est"] = (
    master["population_2023"] * 0.22 * master["poverty_children_u17"] / 100
).round(0).astype(int)

master["food_insecurity_proxy"] = (
    0.6 * master["poverty_all"] + 0.4 * master["unemployment_rate"]
).round(2)

# ── 5. Correlations ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
print("\n=== PEARSON CORRELATIONS vs food_insecurity_proxy ===")
for col in ["poverty_all", "poverty_children_u17", "poverty_children_u4",
            "median_income", "unemployment_rate"]:
    r, p = stats.pearsonr(master[col], master["food_insecurity_proxy"])
    sig = "***" if p < 0.001 else "**" if p < 0.01 else "*" if p < 0.05 else ""
    print(f"  {col:<30} r={r:.3f}  p={p:.4f} {sig}")

# ── 6. Rankings ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
print("\n=== TOP 10 MOST FOOD INSECURE STATES ===")
print(master.nlargest(10, "food_insecurity_proxy")[
    ["state", "food_insecurity_proxy", "poverty_all",
     "poverty_children_u17", "unemployment_rate", "median_income"]
].to_string(index=False))

print("\n=== BOTTOM 5 (BEST OFF) ===")
print(master.nsmallest(5, "food_insecurity_proxy")[
    ["state", "food_insecurity_proxy", "poverty_all", "median_income"]
].to_string(index=False))

# ── 7. Save ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
master.to_csv("data/master_dataset.csv", index=False)
print("\nmaster_dataset.csv saved — shape:", master.shape)
print("Columns:", master.columns.tolist())
```
